product_metadata.title: Ling's Moment Wedding Arch Decor Flowers 2 Rows 6.5ft Blush Pink Flower Garlands for Wedding Backdrop Ceremony Decorations

Best alternative to expensive and limited fresh flowers and greeneries. The colors of these artificial flowers are vivid and the type of flowers are not subject to seasonal and region restrictions.
